description: This file contains test code for elliptic curve operations on the P-256 curve, including point addition, Jacobian coordinate conversions, and test vector generation for cryptographic validation.

methods.name: modMul
methods.description: Performs modular multiplication of two big integers within the curve's prime field.

methods.name: toMontgomery
methods.description: Converts a big integer to Montgomery form.

methods.name: fromMontgomery
methods.description: Converts a Montgomery-form big integer back to standard form.

methods.name: isAffineInfinity
methods.description: Checks if a point in affine coordinates represents the point at infinity.

methods.name: randNonZeroInt
methods.description: Generates a random non-zero big integer less than a given maximum.

methods.name: randPoint
methods.description: Generates a random elliptic curve point by scalar multiplication of the base point.

methods.name: toJacobian
methods.description: Converts affine coordinates to Jacobian coordinates for elliptic curve points.

methods.name: printMontgomery
methods.description: Prints a big integer in Montgomery form with a label.

methods.name: printTestCase
methods.description: Prints a test case for elliptic curve point addition in different coordinate representations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Executes various elliptic curve point addition and doubling tests, generating test vectors.

methods.name: newDeterministicRand
methods.description: Creates a deterministic pseudo-random number generator for testing.

methods.name: (r *deterministicRandom) Read
methods.description: Fills a byte slice with deterministic pseudo-random data.
